Reya Network Airdrop Guide: How to Earn RCP in Season 2

Latest Crypto Airdrops 2026

October 5, 2026 by Rickie Sanchez
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 12:55
Instaread

Disclaimer: Crypto airdrops are promotional events where tokens are distributed to existing cryptocurrency holders or to individuals who meet certain criteria. While airdrops can be a way to acquire tokens at no cost, they also involve risks. There’s no guarantee that the airdropped tokens will increase in value, and there may be associated fees or requirements. Airdrops can also be susceptible to scams and phishing attempts. Always exercise caution and verify the legitimacy of any airdrop opportunity before participating.

The Reya Network airdrop is confirmed, with 45% of the REYA token supply reserved for the community and the first distribution planned for the token generation event (TGE).

Reya has not yet announced the TGE date, the size of the first airdrop or a fixed conversion rate between Reya Chain Points (RCP) and REYA.

The latest campaign is in its second season, which launched alongside Reya v2 on September 28, 2026. Users can earn weekly RCP through three tracks by trading, srUSD staking and signal contributions. 

Access is initially restricted to selected Season 1 traders and market makers, while other users can join the waitlist for later access waves.

What Is Reya Network?

Reya Network is a perpetual decentralized exchange (DEX) built as a zero-knowledge rollup on Ethereum.

The platform is designed for high-speed derivatives trading while using Ethereum for settlement and security. Reya describes its infrastructure as capable of sub-millisecond execution and supports cross-margin trading across multiple perpetual markets.

Its ecosystem also uses rUSD, a USDC-backed accounting asset used for margin and fees, and srUSD, which users can hold for yield while using the balance as trading collateral.

Reya’s margin system allows account balances to support multiple derivatives positions and recognizes profit and loss across eligible positions. Positions can be liquidated when a user’s margin balance falls below the required safety threshold.

Currently, Season 2 introduces Reya’s order book-focused v2 platform, beginning with markets for ETH, BTC, SOL, HYPE and XRP before expanding to additional cryptocurrencies and traditional asset references.

Is the Reya Network Airdrop Confirmed?

Yes. Reya’s tokenomics allocate 45% of the REYA supply to the community, with distribution beginning through an airdrop at TGE. However, three major details remain undisclosed:

  • The REYA TGE date
  • The percentage of supply allocated to the first airdrop
  • The RCP-to-REYA conversion formula

The full 45% community allocation should therefore not be interpreted as the initial airdrop size.

Reya says the first distribution will be followed by additional community airdrops, with governance and the Reya Foundation determining future timing and allocation sizes.

Table 1. Reya Network Airdrop and REYA Token Status

How to Be Eligible for the Reya Network Airdrop?

Reya uses RCP to track participation across its rewards program. Season 2 splits the weekly RCP supply across three main tracks:

Trading

Trading receives the largest share of weekly RCP. Rewards are primarily based on factors such as the following:

  • Trading volume
  • Open interest
  • Continued trading activity

Holding an open position can therefore contribute alongside completed trades.

Staking

Users can convert rUSD into srUSD and hold it in their Reya margin account. The srUSD balance earns yield, can continue supporting trading positions and receives staking RCP when held during the relevant weekly snapshot.

Signal

Signal rewards users who contribute to Reya’s wider ecosystem. Examples include the following:

  • Research
  • Trading tools
  • Educational content
  • Guides
  • Bringing new traders into the ecosystem

Unlike trading and staking RCP, signal allocations are discretionary. Reya can decide which contributions qualify and how much RCP they receive.

If you are tracking other campaigns besides Reya Network, our airdrops page covers the active campaigns worth watching right now.

How to Participate in the Reya Network Airdrop

Season 2 currently has restricted access, so the first step depends on whether your wallet has already been whitelisted.

Connect Your Wallet or Join the Waitlist

Open the official Reya app and connect an Ethereum Virtual Machine (EVM)-compatible wallet such as MetaMask.

Season 1 traders and selected market makers who have been whitelisted can enter Reya v2 immediately.

Other wallets currently see a waitlist screen.

Joining the waitlist gives you a place for future access waves but does not itself guarantee an REYA allocation.

Reya also plans to introduce Golden Tickets, which give holders immediate access when it becomes available.

Deposit USDC

Once your wallet has access, select Deposit. Users can currently deposit USDC from Ethereum or Arbitrum.

Deposited USDC appears inside Reya as rUSD, which is used for margin, trading and other platform activity.

Only deposit an amount you are prepared to put at trading risk. Reya is a leveraged derivatives platform, so funds used as margin can be lost through unsuccessful trades or liquidation.

Trade Supported Markets

Open Reya’s trading interface and choose a market. The initial Season 2 markets include the following:

  • ETH
  • BTC
  • SOL
  • HYPE
  • XRP

Users can place limit or market orders. Both trading volume and open interest contribute to the trading RCP track, so opening and maintaining positions can influence rewards.

Avoid generating unnecessary trades purely for points. Trading costs, funding and losses can easily exceed the eventual value of an unknown airdrop allocation.

Stake rUSD for srUSD

Open the Stake tab and convert eligible rUSD into srUSD.

srUSD can remain in the margin account, where it can earn yield while also contributing to staking RCP.

Your balance needs to be present during the applicable weekly snapshot to count toward the staking track.

The amount of RCP you earn depends on Reya’s weekly distribution, not a guaranteed fixed REYA return.

Use the Reya Referral Program

Open the Rewards tab and copy your referral link. According to the current campaign terms, referrers receive the following:

  • 10% of the RCP earned by referred users
  • 10% of their trading fees

The referral share does not reduce the referee’s own RCP balance. This can increase campaign participation for users with an audience, although referred traders still face the normal risks of leveraged trading.

Earn Signal Points

Users can also contribute through the Signal track without depositing trading capital. Potential contributions include publishing:

  • Reya research
  • Trading dashboards
  • Tools
  • Educational threads
  • Tutorials or guides

Signal rewards are discretionary, so creating content does not guarantee RCP.

Users can check the Rewards tab after each weekly distribution to see how many points they earned across trading, staking and Signal.

How Do Reya Chain Points Work?

RCP is the measurement system Reya currently uses for its community rewards. Reya distributes a fixed amount of RCP weekly across the three reward tracks, with trading receiving the largest share.

Table 2. Reya Season 2 RCP Reward Tracks

RCP is expected to determine each user’s share of REYA community distributions, but Reya has not published a fixed formula such as “1 RCP = X REYA.”

That means users can compare their relative RCP position but cannot yet accurately calculate the value of a future token allocation.

What Changed With Reya Season 2?

Season 2 began with the launch of Reya v2 on September 28, 2026.

The season is designed to help build liquidity and order book depth before wider access.

Unlike a fully open points campaign, Reya is initially restricting access to a smaller group, mainly qualifying Season 1 traders and institutional market makers.

The project says this smaller early group can receive a larger relative share of available rewards.

Markets are also being introduced gradually. The first group covers major crypto assets, while later phases are expected to introduce:

  • Altcoins
  • Commodities
  • Indices
  • Equities

After the initial setup period, Reya plans to distribute Golden Tickets that provide immediate platform access.

Is the Reya Network Airdrop Free?

Not for most participants. The trading and staking reward tracks require users to deposit USDC, while trading exposes participants to:

  • Market losses
  • Liquidation risk
  • Funding costs
  • Transaction costs
  • Smart contract risk

The Signal track provides an alternative for users who want to contribute through content or tools without depositing trading capital.

Referrals can also generate RCP, but they depend on other users participating.

How Will RCP Convert Into REYA?

The exact conversion mechanism has not been published. Reya has confirmed that RCP forms the basis of its community rewards program, but users currently do not know:

  • Total RCP that will exist before TGE
  • REYA allocated to the first round
  • Whether conversion will be linear
  • Whether individual tracks receive different token weights
  • Final sybil filtering rules

The 45% community allocation will also be distributed across multiple rounds rather than entirely at the first TGE airdrop.

What Happens if You Missed Reya Season 1?

Missing Season 1 does not automatically exclude you from the REYA airdrop.

However, users who were not whitelisted for the initial Reya v2 rollout may need to wait before participating in Season 2 trading and staking.

Those users can join the waitlist and wait for later access waves or obtain a Golden Ticket once the system launches.

After gaining access, they can participate in the same Season 2 RCP system.

Earlier users may still have an advantage because they have already accumulated activity and potentially gained earlier access, but Reya has confirmed that community distributions will continue beyond the initial TGE airdrop.

What Are the Main Reya Airdrop Risks?

The biggest risk is that the highest-reward activities involve leveraged perpetual trading. Users should consider the following:

Liquidation Risk

A leveraged position can be forcibly closed if the margin balance falls below Reya’s required threshold.

Unknown Airdrop Value

No TGE date, REYA price or RCP conversion rate has been disclosed.

Trading Costs

Funding, spreads and losing trades can make farming more expensive than the eventual token allocation.

Sybil Filtering

Reya says it may remove wallets identified as sybils before distribution.

Smart Contract Risk

Reya operates through blockchain-based infrastructure, so depositing funds introduces protocol and smart contract risks in addition to trading risk.

Is the Reya Network Airdrop Worth Farming?

The Reya Network airdrop may be worth exploring for users who already trade perps and understand margin, funding rates and liquidation risk.

The campaign has a stronger confirmation level than many speculative airdrops because REYA is confirmed, 45% of supply is reserved for community distribution and the first airdrop is planned for TGE.

What remains unknown is equally important.

Reya has not disclosed the first airdrop size, TGE date or RCP conversion rate, so there is currently no reliable way to calculate whether aggressive trading purely for points will be profitable.

For experienced traders who were already planning to use Reya, accumulating RCP can provide an additional incentive. For beginners, the Signal track or waiting for broader access may be safer than opening leveraged positions solely to farm an unknown token allocation.

The best approach is to treat RCP as an additional reward for useful activity rather than a reason to take trading risks you would otherwise avoid.

Frequently Asked Questions

Need a refresher? Here are the questions most readers ask about the Reya Network airdrop and Season 2.

Is the Reya Network Airdrop Confirmed?

Yes. Reya has confirmed that its community token allocation begins with an airdrop at TGE. A total of 45% of REYA supply is reserved for community distribution across multiple rounds.

When Is the REYA Airdrop?

The first REYA airdrop is planned for TGE, but Reya has not announced the TGE date or the amount of REYA allocated to the first round.

How Do I Earn Reya Chain Points?

Users can earn RCP through trading, holding srUSD during weekly snapshots, Signal contributions and referrals. Trading receives the largest share of the weekly RCP supply.

Does 45% of REYA Supply Go to the First Airdrop?

No. The 45% figure covers the broader community allocation. Reya plans multiple airdrops, and it has not published the percentage assigned to the first TGE distribution.

Can I Join Reya Season 2 if I Missed Season 1?

Yes, but access may not be immediate. Reya v2 initially opened to whitelisted Season 1 traders and market makers. Other users can join the waitlist and gain access through later waves or Golden Tickets.
